title: capsicum annuum var. angulosum
intro: Capsicum annuum var. angulosum, commonly known as the 'Bird's Eye Chili' or 'Bird's Eye Pepper', is a variety of hot pepper plant that belongs to the Capsicum genus. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving circulation due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum annuum var. angulosum include stimulating digestion, relieving respiratory issues, and acting as a circulatory agent, while its bioactive constituents include capsaicin, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The capsaicin present in this plant is known to have analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine.
